How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your Outlet Plug-In Wax Warmer and Vanilla Sandalwood melts, here’s a simple first run:
Read the instructions and safety information that come with the warmer. If there’s plastic around its bulb, remove it before turning the warmer on.
Put the included silicone dish in place, then add 1–2 wax melt bears. Don’t add water or oil.
Plug in and turn on the warmer, following its instructions. Don’t move it while the wax is hot.
When you’re finished, turn it off and unplug it. Let the wax cool and harden before popping it out of the silicone dish.
That’s it—you can start with just one bear and see how you like the scent!
